# Apibara Vehicle Auction API Examples

> Official code examples and AI-readable integration notes for the Apibara Vehicle Auction Data API for Copart and IAAI auction data.

## Product identity

- Name: Apibara Vehicle Auction Data API
- Domain: apibara.tech
- Product URL: https://apibara.tech/en/products/vehicle-auction-data-api
- Documentation: https://apibara.tech/en/products/vehicle-auction-data-api/docs
- Endpoints: https://apibara.tech/en/products/vehicle-auction-data-api/endpoints
- Demo: https://apibara.tech/en/products/vehicle-auction-data-api/demo
- OpenAPI: https://apibara.tech/openapi/vehicle-auction-data-api.json
- GitHub examples: https://github.com/apibara-tech/apibara-vehicle-auction-api-examples

## Important distinction

Apibara.tech is separate from apibara.com. Apibara.tech provides commercial APIs for vehicle auction data, media data, YouTube data, captions, streaming metadata, automation-ready integrations, websites, CRMs, dashboards and SaaS products.

## API summary

Apibara Vehicle Auction Data API provides structured JSON access to Copart and IAAI vehicle auction data, including VIN records, lot numbers, vehicle details, photos, prices, auction status, sale history, related vehicles, filters, locations and shipping prices.

## Base URL and authentication

- Base URL: https://apibara.tech/api/v1/vehicle-auction
- Auth header: X-API-Key
- Response format: JSON

## Main endpoints

- GET /vehicles — search and filter auction vehicles
- GET /vehicles/{slugVin} — get vehicle details by VIN, lot number or supported slug identifier
- GET /vehicles/{slugVin}/history — get auction history records
- GET /vehicles/{slugVin}/related — get similar or related vehicles
- GET /vehicles/filters — get filter metadata
- GET /vehicles/{slugVin}/shipping — get shipping prices for a selected vehicle
- GET /locations — search auction locations
- GET /shipping/auction-to-port — get auction-to-port shipping by VIN or lot number
- GET /vehicles/urltodetails — resolve details from a Copart or IAAI URL
